lines.en: Another layer of dust in my white fur.

lines.zh: 稀树草原的风，带不来雪。
lines.en: The savanna wind brings no snow.
Over two hundred health — wear me down slowly.

lines.zh: 我一步三晃，草都被我踩平。
lines.en: Each slow step of mine flattens the grass.
The sun burns a notch hotter.
Sand works into my fur. Itchy.
This stone wasn't here yesterday.
These soles don't mind the stones.
I pass, and the dry grass falls.
The soil cracks dry beneath me.

lines.zh: 草原上的热风，吹不散我的霜。
lines.en: Savanna heat can't melt my frost.
Slow down; the hot wind burns.

lines.zh: 草原的干热里，我一呼气就结霜。
lines.en: In the dry heat, my breath frosts.

lines.zh: 草叶上的露水正好，慢慢喝。
lines.en: Dew on the grass is just right; I drink slowly.

lines.zh: 旱地的太阳晒着，别来打扰。
lines.en: Basking in the dryland sun, do not disturb.
One breath of frost and the grass whitens.

lines.zh: 这草原，几百年都一个样。
lines.en: This savanna looks the same for centuries.
The grass at my feet waits for my frost.
There is water underground. I hear it.

lines.zh: 热带草原的雪兽，本就奇怪。
lines.en: A snow beast on the savanna is already strange.

lines.zh: 旱地的雪人，也会吐出霜。
lines.en: Even a dry-land yeti breathes frost.

lines.zh: 我这副大白身子，草都盖不住。
lines.en: Grass cannot hide this white bulk.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我最懂时间。
lines.en: Still as I am, I know time best.

lines.zh: 我的影子在雪上又长一截。
lines.en: My shadow lengthens on the snow.
The savanna sun can't melt me.

lines.zh: 雪线以上的风，吹不动我。
lines.en: Wind above the snowline cannot move me.
The sun is fierce. I'll doze.
Under this long fur, it's cool.

lines.zh: 草原这么干，我的冰霜在喉咙里攒着。
lines.en: This savanna is so dry; frost gathers in my throat.

lines.zh: 热风把毛吹得乱七八糟。
lines.en: The hot wind wrecks my fur.
You block my sun. Move.
Two-legs are rare on the savanna.
You have no fur. Aren't you cold?
This season, you're dressed too thin.
This dry riverbed is mine.

lines.zh: 霜从我的嘴里出来，暖的。
lines.en: Frost leaves my mouth, and it is warm.

lines.zh: 离我远点，我呼出的气会冻。
lines.en: Keep back — my breath freezes.

lines.zh: 我的冰霜吐息，能冻住骨头。
lines.en: My frost breath freezes bone.

lines.zh: 这片旱草，我一听就知道。
lines.en: These dry grasses — I know them by sound.

lines.zh: 稀树草原的雪怪，就是我。
lines.en: The yeti of the savanna. That is me.
So you're the one Arid Yeti mentioned.

lines.zh: 你是来找水，还是来找死。
lines.en: Here for water, or for death?
A red line in my white fur.
It hurts enough to make me breathe frost.
This thick coat took the blow.
I hold the frost breath back—for now.
This fur turns an axe.

lines.zh: 热带高原上，我一开口就是霜。
lines.en: On the plateau, one breath of mine is frost.
Who's snapping the twigs off my plating?
Two hundred forty points. I can take it.
A tuft of fur lost; no matter.

lines.zh: 旱地雪人的皮，晒得发硬。
lines.en: The arid yeti's hide dries hard in the sun.
Water? On this savanna it's gold.
Put the water down. Three steps back.
Move that water this way.

lines.zh: 我的毛都朝你竖起来了。
lines.en: My fur rises toward you.

lines.zh: 这地方没有雪，我的毛全干了。
lines.en: There is no snow here; my coat has gone dry.
This grass isn't enough to chew.
A handful of grass is all.

lines.zh: 你手里的，抵得上一条河。
lines.en: What you hold is worth a river.
I smell water; my throat moves.

lines.zh: 草原的热风里，我吐着冰霜。
lines.en: In the savanna heat, I breathe frost.
Fine, step back — mind the fur.
The hollow you stepped in is mine.
My frost breath settles on the leaves.
You bump like the hot wind.

lines.zh: 我的冰霜吐息能冻倒牛。
lines.en: My frost breath could drop an ox.

lines.zh: 你踩进我影子里，凉快吧。
lines.en: Stepped into my shadow — cooler?
Hey — my white fur's dirty!

lines.zh: 二百四十点血，撞一下算什么。
lines.en: Two hundred and forty points. A bump is nothing.
That tuft took ten years to grow.
Bumping my fur only tickles.
This white coat is for you.
Two hundred forty health; let's talk slowly.

lines.zh: 草原上的雪妖，喘口气就结霜。
lines.en: A snow fiend on the savanna — my breath frosts over.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，让我站不稳。
lines.en: Your scent makes me unsteady.

lines.zh: 日头把我们的影子拉长了。
lines.en: The sun stretches our shadows together.
The dry season is long; let's not wait.

lines.zh: 雪原上，我的吐息结成了霜。
lines.en: On the snowfield, my breath turns to frost.
I give you my thickest fur.
When the frost melts, we'll talk.
My frost breath settles on the grass.
A shiny stone — rare on the savanna.
Bury it in sand; next year it's still sand.
This bone goes under the grass.
I dug it out with my claws.

lines.zh: 热带草原的干风，我受得住。
lines.en: I can bear the savanna's dry wind.
Round enough to tuck in my fur.
A little ice to hold in my mouth all day.

lines.zh: 冻原上的东西，不会坏吧。
lines.en: Things on the tundra don't rot, right?

lines.zh: 两百四十点生命，够我站很久。
lines.en: Two hundred forty health; I stand a long time.
First sniff — any water in it?
Every step I take leaves a patch of cold.
Turn around. I'm right here.

lines.zh: 草原上的霜是我走过的。
lines.en: The frost on the savanna is my trail.
Fine. Don't blame me.
You can't outrun me on the savanna.

lines.zh: 你身上有水汽，我闻到了。
lines.en: You carry moisture. I smell it.

lines.zh: 稀树草原这么旱，我照样活。
lines.en: This dry savanna and I still get by.
The grass is too short. You can't hide.
Frost is already in my throat.

lines.zh: 热带草原的旱季里，我呼出的霜。
lines.en: In the savanna's dry season, my breath frosts.

lines.zh: 热带草原上的雪怪就是我。
lines.en: I'm the yeti of this dry savanna.
No hurry. The savanna is wide.
I'm slow, but this plain never ends.
Don't run. The grass tells me.
Further ahead is my wind gap.
The wind carries your scent.
Your steps snap the grass too loud.
You can't outrun this dry plain.
I exhale and the grass frosts over.
The dry grass records every step.
Stand firm. The frost is coming.
Take my palm — with frost.
Move — here comes my palm.
Time to settle up, plains-walker.
This one's for the dry grass.

lines.zh: 我这身霜毛，蹭你一下试试。
lines.en: Let me brush you with this frosted coat.
One frost breath is all it takes.
These claws mark even stone.
Frost breath — dodging won't help.
The savanna wind taught me this swing.
Who dropped me on this dry land?
I rise from the dry grass.
This white coat takes soil today.
Has the rain come? I've waited.
Let me sun first, then talk.
The hot wind smells of strangers.
My frost breath makes grass brittle.
Slept the whole dry season. Thirsty.
The ground under me is still hot.
Dry grass still stuck in my fur.

lines.zh: 我的冰霜吐息，先含在嘴里。
lines.en: I hold my frost breath behind my teeth.
No water here. I shouldn't have come.
Fire? My coat fears it most.
Falling from height, my head still spins.
Water soaks my fur. Too heavy.
Ears ringing, fur all on end.
Even through this long fur, arrows hurt.
That light is wrong, cold to the bone.
Thirst hurts more than hunger.

lines.zh: 两百四十点血，雷也不够。
lines.en: Two hundred forty health — lightning isn't enough.
Under the void there isn't even soil.
